title: World Records
claims: World Athletics publishes world records by event and category.
The records list marks records that are pending ratification.
Road-running record tables distinguish mixed-gender and women-only races.
The page lists records by event and category, distinguishes mixed and women-only road records, and marks records pending ratification.

verification.note: 官方 World Records 表格与图例可读。

claimVerification.note: 页面标题 World Records，含类别选择与按项目列出的表格。
多条成绩带“*”，图例："* Pending ratification."
路跑行标 "Mx"/"Wo"，图例："Mx: mixed gender race. Wo: women only race."
页面可佐证分类、混合/女子表和待批准状态；删除“不是任何地方最快成绩”的明文归因。
